groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.814% and the 10Y at 5.279%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 5 consecutive sessions. QQQ is +2.67% over five sessions and +3.64% versus its 20-day average. Brent is -1.69% at about $98.62, providing some inflation relief.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (+0/100, 56% confidence, improving ↑). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum, falling oil on the supportive side versus weaker intraday semiconductor leadership as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.279%, semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction. Elevated consolidation risk is reducing conviction in the directional setup.
